workflow: A caller clones an existing executable metadata object while changing its parameter-count fields.
The replacement supplies an extreme positional-parameter count and an inconsistent keyword-only count that do not match the stored parameter layout.
Internal validation compares the altered counts with the object’s remaining metadata and detects the violated construction invariants.
The operation raises an internal system error instead of returning a recoverable invalid-metadata error.
summary: Inconsistent executable metadata triggers internal validation error
decision_reason: The failure is malformed low-level executable metadata rejected during invariant validation; none of the existing clusters describes this workflow materially.
